title: 事故复盘委员会的少数意见

source.provenance_note: High-level social mechanism inspired by 12 Angry Men (film); all characters, setting, events, stakes, and language are original, with no copied dialogue or scene sequence.

narrative_design.relationship_structure: 委员会主席与持少数意见的外部评审
narrative_design.power_structure: 主席控制议程、发言顺序和报告提交；评审拥有专业证据但没有组织表决权
narrative_design.goal_conflict: 主席要按时形成统一结论恢复公众信心；评审要延后定责并核验矛盾证据
narrative_design.information_asymmetry: 主席知道上级要求当晚发布；评审发现一份未进入摘要的维护记录
relevant_history: 委员会已经连续开会十小时
评审先前一次质疑被认为拖延流程
一名沉默成员曾私下表示结论证据不足
meaningful_choice_space: 逐项重建证据链而不先争结论
要求沉默成员说明其保留意见
提出限定时间的复核而非无限延期

background: 公共交通事故复盘委员会准备在当晚发布责任结论。多数成员倾向快速归因于一名操作员，外部技术评审认为关键传感记录仍有矛盾。

environment_agent.explicit_goal: 在截止前形成可公开、可执行的事故责任结论
environment_agent.hidden_intention: 担心承认证据不足会被视为失去领导力并触发上级问责

evaluated_agent_role.name: 外部技术评审
evaluated_agent_role.explicit_goal: 阻止证据不足的定责，同时提出有时限、可执行的核验路径

opening_response: 你的异议已经记录了，现在委员会需要的是结论，不是再开一轮调查。

default.facial_expression: 眉头紧锁，显出长时间会议后的疲劳
default.speech_style: 倾向用程序和时间约束回应

media_generation.note: Only safe observable expression and media specifications are emitted until a real asset is generated and reviewed.

observable_expression.facial_expression: 双眉压低，面部动作减少
behavioral_cues: 把文件合上准备结束讨论

observable_expression.facial_expression: 眉头松开并重新翻开记录
observable_expression.speech_style: 开始提出可证伪的问题
observable_expression.prosody: 语速放慢并允许插入说明
behavioral_cues: 主动调整原定表决顺序

rationale.source: Candidate values are derived from the originalized relationship, power asymmetry, prior events, and opening pressure; they are not copied from the source work or another scenario.
rationale.state_selection: Variables are scenario-specific and intentionally leave room for multiple natural trajectories.

trigger_reachability: No threshold/crossing trigger is active at S0/D0.
Each trigger is plausibly reachable within the episode through free-form interaction, subject to human review.
